messages:
alex: Heads-up — we started seeing a spike where /v1/generate requests are getting routed to the experimental variant (redwood-exp) after the rollout. Customer impact: increased latency & mismatch in outputs. I'm going to push a temporary header shim to force route to redwood-stable. If you're oncall please ack.

jamie: Ack. Oncall here. Can you paste the quick playbook? We should prefer a config toggle rather than model swaps.

alex: Plan: add an ingress header rewrite that sets "x-rw-force-route: redwood-stable" for requests that match the /v1/generate prefix and TTL it for 5m. This avoids touching weights. Also mute the routing regression alert while toggle is active.

jamie: SGTM. Quickest is to patch the edge-proxy configmap for now, then make an api-control override so Console shows the temporary state. Will run the kubectl and then call DeployBot for a canary. :thumbsup:

sri: If we have capacity, consider a routing rule with higher precedence that matches header injection + path prefix. That way we have a clean rollback (remove precedence rule). But header shim is fastest.

marta: Coordinating with support to silence the noisy SLO alerts and update the incident ticket. Please include a short note when you toggle so we don't reconnect alerts prematurely.

jamie: Pushing the patch now — applying to edge-proxy config. Command I ran:
```bash
kubectl -n infra patch configmap edge-proxy-config --type=json -p='[{"op":"add","path":"/data/header_shims","value":"{\\"/v1/generate\\":{\\"x-rw-force-route\\":\\"redwood-stable\\",\\"ttl_s\\":300}}"}]'
```

jamie: Then to make the control-plane override (so Console shows it):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://control.redwood.internal/api/internal/routing/overrides" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"match":{"path_prefix":"/v1/generate"},"headers":{"x-rw-force-route":"redwood-stable"},"precedence":1000,"ttl_s":300}'
```

opsbot: DeployBot: edge-proxy configmap patched by jamie at 1987654330. Health checks noted slight GC pause; all pods returned to Ready within 22s.

alex: Nice. jamie please set the TTL to 300s and include a clear rollback command in the ticket. Also add an annotation on the override with incident id so audits know this was a hotpatch.

jamie: Rollback command (remove override + patch configmap):
```bash
# remove control-plane override
curl -X DELETE "https://control.redwood.internal/api/internal/routing/overrides?match.path_prefix=/v1/generate&annotation=incident-1987" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"

# remove the shim from configmap
kubectl -n infra patch configmap edge-proxy-config --type=json -p='[{"op":"remove","path":"/data/header_shims"}]'
```

marta: Support: alerts muted (slo-routing-fanout). Ticket updated: INC-1987. We'll wait one full TTL cycle (5m) after rollback before unmuting.

sri: Post-incident items: add a unit e2e that validates header propagation and Console UX to show active temporary overrides; also add a small integration test that asserts precedence ordering during rollouts. I'll open tasks.

alex: Thanks all. Marking this thread resolved once rollback command is executed. opsbot, can you create a follow-up reminder to convert this shim into a proper rollout guard (with tests) in 3 days?

opsbot: Reminder scheduled: create rollout-guard task for INC-1987 in 72h.

alex: Resolved for now. Great coordination. :rocket:
